background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook. Leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks and CET1 of 12.0% is just below the peer median, but LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, which is the weak spot. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points, while LCR has been broadly flat. Recent news is mostly good on earnings, and the newest flag, on 9 Oct 2026, is a business headline about new fund administration work rather than a credit event.
